crossRefs.note: Then the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be called to tell the king…
The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told…
When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,”…
“Stand now with your enchantments and with the multitude of your sorceries, in which you have labored from your youth…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream.
translations.bsb: So I issued a decree that all the wise men of Babylon be brought before me to interpret the dream for me.
translations.kjv: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream.
